DECLARE @DatetoProcessed date
set @DatetoProcessed = '2020-02-04'

select top 1 * from BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber where @DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATETIME2,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')  --and customeraccountid = '6cb1963e420a6248f04eeac0cc939594'


select distinct PeriodStartTimestamp, PeriodEndTimestamp, replace(isnull(PeriodEndTimestamp,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31'), SourceCode from BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber where sourcecode = 'crm'

@DatetoProcessed between periodstartdate and replace(isnull(periodenddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') 
@DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATETIME2,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') 

select distinct PeriodStartTimestamp, PeriodEndTimestamp, replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATETIME2,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31'), SourceCode from BNKM.CustomerTelephoneNumber

select distinct PeriodStartTimestamp, PeriodEndTimestamp, replace(isnull(PeriodEndTimestamp,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31'), SourceCode from BNKM.CustomerLocation

select distinct PeriodStartTimestamp, PeriodEndTimestamp, replace(isnull(convert(date,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31'), SourceCode from BNKM.CustomerEmail 

SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty  - @DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATE,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') 
SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerMaritalStatus - @DatetoProcessed between periodstartdate and replace(isnull(periodenddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')
SELECT * FROM BNKM.AtmCustomerRelatedCustomer - @DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimestamp and replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATETIME,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') 


select distinct PeriodStartTimestamp, PeriodEndTimestamp, replace(isnull(CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31'), SourceSystemCode from BNKM.CustomerRelatedParty where SourceSystemCode = 'SEC'

select distinct periodstartdate, periodenddate, replace(isnull(periodenddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31'), SourceCode from BNKM.CustomerEmployment where SourceCode = 'CCD'



SELECT distinct PeriodStartTimestamp, PeriodEndTimestamp, replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATETIME2,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31'), SourceCode FROM BNKM.CustomerEmail

select distinct PeriodStartTimestamp, PeriodEndTimestamp, replace(isnull(CONVERT(DATE,PeriodEndTimestamp),'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31'), SourceCode from BNKM.Customerlocation where SourceSystemCode = 'CRM'
